description: The EF Core session that holds the model, the connection and the change tracker for one unit of work.
The queryable set of one entity type on a context, the starting point for LINQ queries and for `Add` and `Remove`.
The default mapping rules, such as `Id` as primary key and `CategoryId` plus a navigation as a foreign key, that the Fluent API or attributes override.
Mapping configuration written in `OnModelCreating` with `ModelBuilder`, such as lengths, precision and indexes.
The part of the context that snapshots loaded entities and turns their changes into `INSERT`, `UPDATE` and `DELETE` statements on `SaveChangesAsync`.
The pattern EF Core follows: collect every change during a business operation and write them together in one `SaveChangesAsync` call.
The DI lifetime `AddDbContext` uses, so each HTTP request gets its own context that is disposed when the request ends.
